User todo file convention notes/todo.md: The user maintains a todo list at notes/todo.md and prefers standard Markdown checkbox formatting, including using '- [x]' to mark completed items.

Assistant todo file maintenance convention notes/todo.md: When maintaining notes/todo.md, Assistant records the current date as the first line, asks the user for todo item content rather than inventing it, and appends items while marking completed ones.

Assistant todo item content sourcing todo item: When appending todo items to notes/todo.md, the assistant asks the user to supply the item content rather than inventing it, and confirms what is already present in the file before adding.
